programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 002: Valentine’s Day Love, Kendrick Lamar’s Super Bowl Performance, & NBA All-Star Weekend Highlights
programme.desc: In this exciting first episode of Mic’d Up: The Podcast, hosts Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith dive into all the hottest topics of the season! From the magic of Valentine’s Day love to Kendrick Lamar’s unforgettable Super Bowl halftime performance, this episode covers it all. Plus, get the inside scoop on the NBA All-Star Weekend, the biggest highlights, and what made it so memorable. Join us for a fun and lively conversation about music, sports, and everything in between!

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 003: Nike Scandal, Lakers x One Piece Collab, and LA’s Strict Nightlife Rules & Discrimination
programme.desc: In this episode of Mic’d Up: The Podcast, Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith tackle some of the hottest topics in pop culture and beyond. First up: The mystery behind stolen Nikes—did Nike orchestrate the theft themselves? Then, they dive into the collaboration between the Lakers and One Piece, along with opening exclusive One Piece trading cards! The conversation heats up as they discuss the SAG Awards and the controversial nightlife rules and discrimination issues in big cities like LA. Tune in for an insightful, no-holds-barred discussion on current events and pop culture!

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 004: Oscar Buzz, Pokémon Prismatic ETB Box Break, and the Mavericks' Downfall with Kyrie Irving
programme.desc: In this exciting episode of Mic'd: The Podcast Mic & Daniel dive into the latest buzz from the Oscars and what’s making headlines in Hollywood. But that’s not all—things get even more interesting when they break open a Pokémon Prismatic ETB box and explore the world of collectibles. The episode wraps up with a deep dive into the Mavericks’ recent struggles, including Kyrie Irving’s unexpected injury and what this means for the team’s future.

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 005: Running the LA Marathon for Charity, Crypto Talk, NFL Trades & Japanese One Piece Cards
programme.desc: In this episode of Mic'd Up: The Podcast, Michelangelo Falcon shares his personal journey as he prepares to run the LA Marathon this Sunday for charity. He talks about the motivation and drive required to commit to such a challenge and explains how anyone can push themselves to achieve big goals, no matter the obstacles. The conversation then shifts to the world of cryptocurrency, as Michelangelo and Daniel Smith break down the latest trends and discuss NFL trades. To cap off the episode, they open some rare Japanese One Piece trading cards.

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 006: Adan Castillo on Training the Paul Brothers, Motivation & Pulling a Rare Pokémon Card
programme.desc: This week on Mic’d Up: The Podcast, we welcome a special guest—celebrity boxing coach Adan Castillo, the man behind Logan Paul’s training for The Mayweather Fight and Jake Paul’s transition into pro boxing. Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith dive deep into the world of elite training, discussing the mindset, motivation, and sacrifices it takes to succeed at the highest level. Beyond the ring, the conversation expands to the importance of inner circles, overcoming struggles, and the drive to chase your goals—whether you’re a celebrity or an everyday person striving for greatness. To top it off, the guys open Pokémon cards and pull the rarest card yet!

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 007: Morning Routines That Trend, CONCACAF Nations League Soccer, & Jordan 4 Bricks Review
programme.desc: This week's episode of Mic'd Up: The Podcast as Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith unpack the latest trends in morning routines that are sweeping the nation. Discover tips and tricks that might revolutionize your own start to the day. Switching gears, the hosts recap the excitement from the recent CONCACAF Nations League soccer games, discussing standout moments and key plays. Plus, don't miss their exclusive review of the sneaker of the year, the Jordan 4 "Bricks" by Nigel Sylvester.

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 008: Avatar's Return, Nokia's Viral Video, Coachella Hype, NBA's Marketing Moves, NFL Rule Changes
programme.desc: Episode 008 of Mic'd Up: The Podcast, Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith delve into the buzz surrounding the upcoming Avatar movie, discussing its potential impact and fan expectations. They analyze Nokia's latest music video that's taking the internet by storm and share their excitement for the approaching Coachella festival, highlighting anticipated performances and trends. The conversation shifts to the NBA, where they examine recent player suspensions and debate whether marketing strategies are influencing league decisions more than ever. They also unpack the NFL's new rule changes for 2025, exploring how adjustments to overtime and kickoff rules could affect game dynamics and betting landscapes . To top it all off, the hosts open a pack of Dragon Ball Z trading cards, aiming for those elusive God Rare cards, and discuss the thrill of collecting and the value of rare finds .

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 009: Coachella Special With The Girls! Festival Drama, Prismatic Evolutions & Dire Wolves Return?
programme.desc: Get festival-ready with this special Coachella episode of Mic'd Up: The Podcast! Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith are joined by three special guests who reveal all the drama, stress, and secrets behind getting Coachella-ready. The excitement continues as they open a Pokémon Prismatic Evolutions box, letting the girls test their luck and pull some heat. Michelangelo also shares highlights from an unforgettable weekend with El Cristiano Tequila. Plus, they dive into the astonishing news of scientists bringing back an extinct species—the Dire Wolf. Don't miss this episode packed with festival tips, rare Pokémon cards, wild stories, and mind-blowing science news!

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 010: Coachella Recap, WNBA Draft Highlights, Tariffs Shaking Fashion, True Religion Denim
programme.desc: Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith recap Michelangelo’s unforgettable Coachella experience—covering standout performances, behind-the-scenes moments, and festival vibes. They dive into the highlights from the recent WNBA Draft and discuss the future of women's basketball. With tariffs impacting fashion and consumer products, the hosts explore what this means for your favorite brands and trends. Michelangelo showcases his fresh pair of True Religion jeans and shares his personal take on fashion’s latest moves. Plus, could dinosaurs really be making a comeback?

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 011: Sinners, Ryan Coogler's Huge Deal, Oscar Rule Changes, Shannon Sharpe’s Drama & NBA Playoffs!
programme.desc: Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith break down the buzz around the upcoming movie Sinners, and dive into director Ryan Coogler’s groundbreaking deal that's changing the Hollywood landscape. They discuss the Oscars' new rules requiring voters to watch every nominated movie, potentially reshaping award season forever. The conversation heats up when addressing Shannon Sharpe’s lawsuit drama, exploring how legal situations differ between wealthy and not-so-wealthy relationships. In "Smitty’s Corner," Daniel tackles the latest highlights from the NBA Playoffs. Michelangelo also showcases El Cristiano Mezcal’s stunning bottle and introduces listeners to Disney's Labubus.

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 012: 100 Men vs. Gorilla Debate, Stagecoach Stories, Sanders Draft Snub & Epic Pokémon Mewtwo Pull!
programme.desc: Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith ignite the ultimate debate—can 100 men actually defeat one gorilla? The duo also dives into the buzz from Stagecoach Festival, unpacks the controversy surrounding Shedeur Sanders going undrafted, and discusses how ongoing tariffs are impacting businesses and consumers. Things get comedic when Daniel accidentally blocks Michelangelo’s face with a hookah mid-episode! Plus, the hosts open a rare Japanese Pokémon Team Rocket "Destined Rivals" booster box, and you won’t believe the incredible Mewtwo card they pull.

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 013: Diageo's Fake Tequila Lawsuit, Cinco de Mayo Picks, Met Gala Madness & Grading Pokémon Slabs
programme.desc: Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith uncork a wild discussion on the Diageo lawsuit over selling fake tequila—and what it means for the spirits industry. With Cinco de Mayo around the corner, they also shout out some of their favorite Mexican restaurants in Los Angeles and Ventura County you should definitely check out. In true fashion, they dive into the biggest moments and wildest outfits from this year’s Met Gala. During the “Tings I Buy” segment, Michelangelo shows off new Pokémon slab pickups and breaks down how to properly grade your cards. And of course, “Smitty’s Corner” gets heated with NBA Playoffs coverage. It’s tequila, tacos, fashion, slabs, and hoops

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 014: Tariff Troubles, Diddy Trial Buzz, An American Pope? & Labubus Boosts a Billion-Dollar Brand!
programme.desc: Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith cover the latest in global and cultural headlines. They start with fresh updates on the growing impact of tariffs and how they're affecting fashion, trade, and everyday life. The conversation heats up as they discuss the explosive developments in the Diddy trial, diving into what’s fact, what’s speculation, and how it’s shaking the industry. The duo also unpacks the wild concept of a potential American Pope and what that could mean for culture, faith, and global influence. During “Tings I Buy,” Michelangelo talks about Disney’s Labubus and how it’s now powering a $1.6 billion company. Plus, “Smitty’s Corner” breaks down the hottest NBA Playoffs matchups and player performances.

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 015: New Set Vibes, Diddy Case Update, Ginger Identity Debate, NBA Playoff Shocks & Fossil Pokémon
programme.desc: Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith kick things off by unpacking the viral debate—can gingers really be considered Black? Then it’s back to court with the latest updates on the Diddy case and its cultural ripple effects. Planning a getaway? They run down the top 10 cheapest places to travel in 2025. Things take a turn as they expose the dark truth behind Club One and what’s really happening behind the scenes. In this week’s Pokémon segment, the hosts dive into wild card stories, and Michelangelo breaks the news about a Fossil Pokémon museum exhibit coming to the U.S. Finally, Smitty’s Corner covers the absolute shockwaves from the NBA Playoffs.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Eight: Perspective and Peace: Embracing Gratitude
programme.desc: In this episode of 'Pardon My Peace,' Danielle and Shay dive into a thought-provoking discussion about the significance of perspective in our lives. They explore the difference between needs and wants, sharing personal stories and reflecting on how our mindset shapes our appreciation for what we have. The conversation touches on topics like Southern California's unpredictable weather, the desire for new possessions, and the impact of modern society on our perceptions of adequacy. Danielle challenges herself and the listeners to differentiate between 'needs' and 'wants,' emphasizing gratitude and contentment. The episode encourages listeners to reflect on their own lives, offering humorous anecdotes and real-life examples to drive home the message of intentional living and genuine self-reflection.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Eleven: The Weight of a Mother's Faith Our Sickle Cell Testimony Part One
programme.desc: In this heartfelt episode of Pardon My Peace, Danielle shares the moving story of her son, Thomas Parker III, who was born with sickle cell disease. She recounts Parker's birth experience, early health challenges, and the emotional journey from initial diagnosis to ongoing care. With faith, determination, and a strong support system, Danielle navigates the complexities of raising a child with chronic illness, while ensuring he leads a fulfilling life. This episode provides a deep look into the resilience and love that drive a mother's commitment to her child’s well-being.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Five: Empowerment in Solitude: Date Yourself!
programme.desc: In this episode of 'Pardon My Peace,' Danielle and Shay discuss the concept of 'dating yourself.' They explore personal experiences and the benefits of taking time for self-care and doing things solo. The conversation touches on growing confidence, the importance of self-love, and how societal expectations often make such practices challenging. Whether you're single, in a relationship, or a busy mom, they share insights on how to make time for yourself and why it's essential for overall well-being. Tune in for an inspiring discussion on normalizing self-dates, building confidence, and celebrating individuality.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Four: DEA Busts, Fiery Conversations, and Dating Dilemmas
programme.desc: In this episode of 'Pardon My Piece,' hosts Danielle and Shay dive into a lively discussion filled with personal stories and reflections. Filmed during an evening session, they explore topics such as the hosts' preference for nighttime energy, the nap debate, memorable college experiences, and the cultural differences in substance use. They also touch on the impact of natural disasters like California fires, the importance of healthy eating, and Shay's personal revelation about her dating life and the importance of shooting your shot. It's a candid conversation that offers a mix of humor, nostalgia, and genuine advice.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Nine: Fun Facts and True Friendship: How Well Do You Know Me?
programme.desc: Join Danielle and Shay in an engaging and hilarious episode of 'Pardon My Peace' as they dive into a series of personal questions in the game 'How Well Do You Know Me?'. Watch as they share fun facts about each other, discuss their pet peeves, dream jobs, favorite foods, and recall childhood memories. With lots of laughter and heartfelt moments, this episode offers an entertaining way to learn more about these two friends. Take a seat with the ladies and join the Group Chat You Didn't Know You Needed. Don't forget to leave your questions and comments below!

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode One: The Danielle Interview
programme.desc: In this episode, we delve into personal reflections and experiences, including Danielle's journey of self-discovery apart from her roles as a wife and mother. We also discuss overcoming fears and insecurities, such as body dysmorphia, and the ways personal growth shapes our lives. Danielle shares how her son's battle with sickle cell disease strengthened her faith and relationship with God. Join us for honest conversations and a dose of authenticity.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Seven: Unpacking the Burden: Should Women Fix Men?
programme.desc: In this episode, Shay and Danielle dive into the complex topic of whether it's a woman's job to fix a broken man. They discuss their perspectives on emotional intelligence, healing, and the importance of self-improvement in relationships. They touch on societal expectations, gender norms, and the significance of therapy for both men and women. Join in on this deep and meaningful conversation and share your thoughts in the comments. Don't forget to like, subscribe, and follow for more insightful discussions!

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Six: Exploring Femininity: Softness, Strength, and Everything In Between
programme.desc: Join us as we dive into a candid discussion about femininity, challenging traditional notions and exploring what it truly means. We share personal stories, insights, and tips on embracing and celebrating feminine energy. This episode also addresses common misconceptions, highlights the importance of self-awareness and self-care, and offers practical advice to enhance your connection with your inner feminine energy. Whether you're looking to redefine femininity for yourself or simply curious about different perspectives, this episode is for you. Don't forget to like, subscribe, and share your thoughts in the comments!

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Ten: The Friendship Spectrum: From Daily Chats to Timeless Bonds
programme.desc: In this heartfelt episode, Danielle and Shay reflect on personal experiences, discussing the differences between high maintenance and low maintenance friendships. They share a gripping story of a near-miss scare involving Danielle's son, Declan, emphasizing the importance of staying calm in emergencies. The conversation delves into the dynamics of friendships, introversion, extroversion, and the need for self-care. Explore how knowing oneself and others can lead to more meaningful and balanced relationships. Join us for an insightful chat on thriving in both extroverted and introverted spaces without losing oneself!

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Three: Marriage: Commitment, Paper, or Both?
programme.desc: In this heartfelt episode of 'Pardon My Peace,' Danielle interviews her close friend Shay. They discuss Shay's journey to finding faith, the significance of family, and the most important relationships in her life, particularly with her father. The episode also explores their rekindled friendship after years of separation, showcasing the power of honesty, growth, and forgiveness. Shay shares her passions, life lessons, and dreams, making this an inspirational story not just about friendship but also about self-discovery and resilience. Don't miss this authentic conversation filled with humor, love, and real talk. In this episode of Pardon My Peace, hosts Shay and Danielle dive into the thought-provoking topic of whether marriage is overrated. They explore both sides of the debate, discussing how societal views on marriage have evolved over time and the various reasons people choose to get married today. The conversation covers the challenges of maintaining a long-term commitment, the evolving roles of women, and the importance of personal happiness and growth within a marriage. Danielle shares insights from her decade-long marriage, while Shay contemplates her own views on the institution. Tune in for an honest, candid discussion about love, commitment, and the evolving nature of marriage in modern society.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Twelve: The Weight of a Mother's Faith Our Sickle Cell Testimony Part Two
programme.desc: In this heartfelt episode, we explore the inspiring story of Parker, a young boy who battled sickle cell disease and braved the challenges of a bone marrow transplant during the COVID-19 pandemic. His mother shares the emotional and complex journey from early hour shopping to avoid exposure, Parker contracting COVID-19, and the intensive bone marrow transplant process. Discover how Parker's resilience, family support, and their steadfast faith led to his miraculous recovery. This episode delves into the medical, emotional, and spiritual aspects of their experience, highlighting the critical role of testimonies and the importance of becoming an advocate for others facing similar challenges.
